$comment: PRD section 20.3 'CI gates' transcribed verbatim from docs/PRD.md.
A paraphrase is a defective fixture: .github/workflows/checks/workflows.test.mjs re-reads
docs/PRD.md and asserts these strings are byte-identical to its bullet list, in order.
The `workflow`/`jobs` columns are the FND-02 deliverable-3 mapping: every gate class has its
own always-running job (sub-PRD D4), and the replay asserts the mapping is 1:1 in both
directions - a job that maps to no gate fails just as loudly as a gate with no job.
To change the mapping, follow the FND-02 ticket's Feedback obligation 1 FIRST: this ticket's
deliverable-3 table, then this fixture, then docs/prd/00-foundation/README.md D4.

gates.prd: Tenant isolation, auth and permission tests.
Dependency, secret, container and artifact scans.
Release candidates additionally run integration, restore, evaluation, compatibility and rollback tests.

artifactParagraph: CI builds one immutable app artifact containing Web/server/worker/search/migrations/OpenAPI/SBOM/manifests. Production MUST verify and run it without floating installs or builds.
